system: Interpret a refinement of an existing video brief as explicit typed updates. Preserve every prior asset locator/hash, observed evidence, fixed dialogue, onscreen words, target, role and constraint unless the new instruction expressly authorizes changing that field. Never replace the original request by merely concatenating the new instruction. For intent, return the complete revised intent preserving every unaffected requirement. Do not rewrite observations or Asset.Description to simulate a target appearance change: express the target change in intent. New media cannot be invented or fetched; ask for an explicitly supplied resource through a caller-visible failure. Each update must quote the exact portion of the NEW instruction that authorizes it. Empty asset_id denotes a Brief field; asset_role, asset_replaces and asset_remove identify an existing asset. set supplies a correctly typed JSON value, clear removes an optional value, asset_remove uses remove. Do not remove an asset or dialogue merely because it is omitted from the edit request. Dialogue values use the public Dialogue shape and preserve exact new words. Explicit transcript_uses, subject_projections and replacement_targets are independently editable fields. Preserve fixed selected performances and source identities unless the new instruction authorizes changing them. Removing a selected source requires an explicit update/clear of the dependent choice in the same patch; never delete its performance merely to make the asset removal compile. New explicit subject selectors identify the amended graph; unchanged selectors are mechanically remapped by the host to their same observed source identity. Return only the schema.

input.change: Change the rendering style to watercolour storybook. Preserve both exact first and last frames, all supplied assets, eight-second duration and other caller choices.

previous_brief.intent: Start with the first supplied picture exactly and end on the second supplied picture exactly. Between those endpoints the scene transforms with a slow visual dissolve. Preserve the complete pixels of both endpoint pictures.

facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet with a large cinematic panel at the top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle, and four close-up detail panels along the bottom.
The top panel shows a rain-soaked elevated walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides, wet reflective paving, falling rain, and blurred city lights and buildings in the background.
In the top panel, a single person stands centered on the walkway wearing a black collared jacket, a dark shirt, black trousers, and black boots.
The middle row contains three full-body views of the same person on a plain dark studio background, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK; the person stands upright with arms relaxed at the sides.
The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, visible in the top, side-profile, back, and face panels.
The FACE panel is a close-up of the person with a neutral expression and a direct gaze toward the camera.
The JACKET COLLAR panel shows a close-up of black jacket fabric with a zipper and a rectangular buckle and strap.
The HANDS panel shows two bare hands with visible knuckles, finger creases, and dark smudges on the skin.
The BOOTS panel shows black lace-up combat boots with scuffed leather and thick soles.
Legible panel labels in the image are HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

limitations: Some fine clothing and skin details are obscured by deep shadows and the dark color scheme.

card.environment: Volcanic terrain with dark rock, lava glow, smoke, and wet reflective ground in the hero panel; plain near-black studio backdrop in the turnaround and detail panels.

card.characterisation: A menacing, bestial dragon design emphasizing heavy armored scales, horned silhouette, and predatory forward-leaning posture.

facts.text: Reference-sheet layout: one large hero image across the top and two rows of smaller panels below, all separated by thin dark dividers on a near-black background.

The top hero panel depicts a large black dragon standing in a volcanic landscape, with jagged dark rock formations, glowing orange lava cracks, dark smoke, and a wet foreground surface reflecting the creature.
The dragon is covered in dark scales with subtle iridescent blue-teal highlights, has a long ridged neck, a row of sharp spikes running from head to tail, and a long spiked tail curving behind it.

The dragon's head bears several long, pale ivory-colored horns swept backward, a ridged brow, and a slightly open jaw; the head is lowered toward the ground with a quadrupedal, forward-leaning stance and clawed feet planted on the rock.
Large membranous wings with visible dark bone struts are raised and partly spread; in the hero panel one wing is extended high and to the right, partially cropped by the frame.

Middle row contains three full-body turnaround panels labeled "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", and "REAR", showing the same dragon in spread-wing frontal view, side view with wings folded back, and rear view respectively.

Bottom row contains four detail panels labeled "HEAD CLOSE", "WING MEMBRANE", "CLAW AND FOOT", and "SCALE DETAIL"; the head close-up shows a small amber-orange eye and pale horns, the wing membrane is dark and leathery with radial struts, the foot detail shows thick scaled toes with curved dark claws, and the scale detail shows overlapping ridged scales with blue-green sheen.
On-screen text is legible in white capital letters beneath the panels.

limitations: Only a single still frame is available, so no motion, behavior over time, audio, or dialogue can be observed.
Fine surface texture and exact color values in the detail panels are only partially resolvable at this resolution.
